title: Among schools that are either exclusively virtual (Virtual = 'F') or primar
question: Among schools that are either exclusively virtual (Virtual = 'F') or primarily virtual (Virtual = 'V'), find those where the absolute difference between K–12 enrollment and Ages 5–17 enrollment exceeds the county-wide average of such differences for virtual schools. Return the school name, city, county, and this enrollment difference, but only for schools located in counties with at least 3 virtual schools.

prediction.sql:
WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
        s.XCL_050 AS city,
        s.XCL_045 AS county,
        ABS(f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) AS enrollment_diff
    FROM schools s
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_076 IN ('F', 'V')
),
county_stats AS (
    SELECT
        county,
        AVG(enrollment_diff) AS avg_diff,
        COUNT(*) AS virtual_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY county
)
SELECT
    vs.school_name,
    vs.city,
    vs.county,
    vs.enrollment_diff
FROM virtual_schools vs
INNER JOIN county_stats cs ON vs.county = cs.county
WHERE vs.enrollment_diff > cs.avg_diff
  AND cs.virtual_count >= 3

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
        s.XCL_050 AS city,
        s.XCL_045 AS county,
        ABS(f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) AS enrollment_diff
    FROM schools s
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_076 IN ('F', 'V')
),
county_stats AS (
    SELECT
        county,
        AVG(enrollment_diff) AS avg_diff,
        COUNT(*) AS virtual_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY county
)
SELECT
    vs.school_name,
    vs.city,
    vs.county,
    vs.enrollment_diff
FROM virtual_schools vs
INNER JOIN county_stats cs ON vs.county = cs.county
WHERE vs.enrollment_diff > cs.avg_diff
  AND cs.virtual_count >= 3

WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_043 AS school_name,
        s.XCL_045 AS city,
        s.XCL_044 AS county,
        ABS(f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) AS enrollment_diff
    FROM schools s
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE f.XCL_002 IN ('F', 'V')
),
county_stats AS (
    SELECT
        county,
        AVG(enrollment_diff) AS avg_diff,
        COUNT(*) AS virtual_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY county
)
SELECT
    vs.school_name,
    vs.city,
    vs.county,
    vs.enrollment_diff
FROM virtual_schools vs
INNER JOIN county_stats cs ON vs.county = cs.county
WHERE vs.enrollment_diff > cs.avg_diff
  AND cs.virtual_count >= 3
